# jinker

> jinker is a plain JavaScript UI library for browser pages and pywebview frontends. document.oc places elements in CSS grids like Tkinter grid(); the same call builds ready-made widgets by tag.

Load the library with one script tag: web/js/Jinker.js (not async, not defer).

Everything in one file: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ThePenguinEmperor/JsTk@main/llms-full.txt

## Guide

- [SKILL.md](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ThePenguinEmperor/JsTk@main/skills/jinker/SKILL.md): quick start, document.oc essentials, widget list
